result.instructions: Tools for TimeTap, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Review next week's appointment schedule by location and staff."; "List active services and their durations."; "Show the scheduling staff working at this location.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TimeTap data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timetap_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timetap_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timetap_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timetap_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timetap_get_business
tools.title: Get connected business
tools.description: Read the authenticated business ID, name and selected scheduling settings. Excludes billing tokens and payment configuration.

tools.name: timetap_list_staff
tools.title: List scheduling staff
tools.description: GET /staff. Read staff IDs, names and scheduling flags. No contact details, user logins or profiles. Vendor route is unpaginated, bounded here to 5,000 rows/2 MiB. locationId values are sent comma-separated as documented.

tools.name: timetap_list_locations
tools.title: List scheduling locations
tools.description: Read one page of scheduling locations. Continue pageNumber while the returned page is full; vendor provides no total on this route. Excludes private scheduling links, embed codes, email and tax IDs.

tools.name: timetap_list_services
tools.title: List bookable services
tools.description: GET /services. Read service/reason IDs, names, duration and pricing; private PERSONAL reasons are excluded via includePersonal=0. Vendor route is unpaginated, bounded to 5,000 rows/2 MiB. Results reflect the credential's permissions and scheduling filters.

tools.name: timetap_get_staff
tools.title: Get scheduling staff member
tools.description: Read one scheduling staff member by its numeric professionalId. Selected scheduling fields only; clients, notes, form answers, private URLs and other unselected fields are omitted.

tools.name: timetap_get_location
tools.title: Get scheduling location
tools.description: Read one scheduling location by its numeric locationId. Selected scheduling fields only; clients, notes, form answers, private URLs and other unselected fields are omitted.

tools.name: timetap_get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: Read one service by its numeric reasonId. Selected scheduling fields only; clients, notes, form answers, private URLs and other unselected fields are omitted.

tools.name: timetap_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: Read one appointment by its numeric calendarId. Selected scheduling fields only; clients, notes, form answers, private URLs and other unselected fields are omitted.

tools.name: timetap_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointment schedule
tools.description: Read one page from GET /appointmentList/reportWithCount using an ordered YYYY-MM-DD date range (up to 93 days). Client records/contact, subject/notes, forms/custom fields, payment and appointment management links are omitted. PERSONAL time-off is excluded. Local wall-clock numbers are TimeTap HHmm values, not decimal hours; UTC epoch fields are milliseconds. Count is the vendor total; request the next page until exhausted.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with TimeTap
prompts.description: What you can do with TimeTap here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_appointments_for_a_date_range
prompts.title: Review appointments for a date range
prompts.description: List a date range of appointments, filter by staff, location or service, and continue through result pages to review scheduled times and status.

prompts.name: compare_services_for_staff_and_locations
prompts.title: Compare services for staff and locations
prompts.description: Find scheduling staff and locations, then list services for a selected staff member or location to compare durations and prices.

prompts.name: inspect_an_appointment_s_time_and_status
prompts.title: Inspect an appointment’s time and status
prompts.description: Read an appointment by its ID to check its time, status, staff, location and service. Client records, notes and private management links are omitted.

prompts.name: review_a_location_s_scheduling_staff
prompts.title: Review a location’s scheduling staff
prompts.description: Find a scheduling location and list the staff who accept appointments there, using their IDs, names and scheduling flags.
